newsitem.title: UK: LEP France starts Arabian Gulf LCL ocean service.
newsitem.headline: LEP France starts Arabian Gulf LCL ocean service.

text.p: LEP France said that it has introduced a regular LCL (less-than-container-load) shipping service to Dubai, Sharjah, Bahrain, Kuwait and other destinations in the Arabian Gulf.

The service is providing French shippers with guaranteed weekly departures, and fast transit times. For the most part the traffic is being routed via Antwerp and Le Harve to connect with the Maersk Line schedule.
The cargoes are being consolidated in LEP depots in Paris, Le Harve, Lyons, Bordeaux, and other major cities.

Jean-Claude Junin, LEP sales director, said the new service is already proving to be popular with shippers. Among a wide range of commodities being carried are machinery, consumer goods, perfumes and other toiletries, and top quality fashion merchandise. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
